title: A Conservative OCR-Enabled Workflow for R214 Sodium Screening of South African Packaged Foods
abstract: arXiv:2609.15427v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Using food package images to monitor sodium and salt content against South Africa's R214 sodium limits is challenging when screening decisions require product identity, nutrition facts panel evidence, reporting basis, and category-specific thresholds. This study presents a conservative image-based workflow that combines region detection, optical character recognition (OCR), product identity and sodium evidence extraction, R214 category assignment, deterministic threshold comparison, and independent vision language model comparison. The evaluation used 442 packaged food products and 3 929 full package images from a real-world South African food packaging dataset. A YOLO26s small detector generated 4 195 region crops, and strict post-processing produced one sodium evidence row per product. translated_title: 一种用于南非包装食品R214钠含量筛查的保守型OCR工作流程
translated_abstract: 当筛查决策需要产品身份、营养成分表证据、报告依据以及特定类别阈值时，利用食品包装图像监测钠和盐含量是否符合南非R214钠含量限值具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种保守的基于图像的工作流程，该流程结合了区域检测、光学字符识别（OCR）、产品身份与钠证据提取、R214类别分配、确定性阈值比较以及独立的视觉语言模型比较。评估使用了来自真实世界南非食品包装数据集中的442种包装食品和3929张完整包装图像。YOLO26s小型检测器生成了4195个区域裁剪图像，经过严格的后处理，为每个产品生成了一条钠证据记录。集成工作流程产生了290个“超出R214范围”、139个“待审查”、7个“筛查通过”和6个“筛查不通过”的结果。独立的Qwen2.5-VL 7B视觉语言模型…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合区域检测、OCR识别、产品身份验证、确定性阈值比较和独立视觉语言模型对比的保守型图像工作流程，用于筛查南非包装食品是否符合R214钠含量限值，并在442种真实产品数据上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This study presents a conservative image-based workflow combining region detection, OCR, product identity verification, deterministic threshold comparison, and independent vision-language model comparison to screen South African packaged foods against R214 sodium limits, validated on 442 real-world products.
